overview_description.description:
Lidoma is a gaming platform that brings communities together, organizes tournaments and leagues, and broadcasts online/offline events in some of the most popular mobile and PC game titles.

Lidoma is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates and was founded in 2020.

product.name: LIDOMA International Series
product.description: A series of PUBG Mobile tournaments organized by LIDOMA, featuring multiple events with significant prize pools and participation from teams across various regions.

product.name: LIDOMA Reborn
product.description: A VALORANT tournament series organized by LIDOMA, starting with the inaugural event that featured 85 teams from Turkey competing over 15 days.

product.name: LIDOMA Masters Showdown
product.description: A Battlegrounds Mobile India tournament held in the Asian region, featuring 1075 teams and a $5000 prize pool, organized and marketed by LIDOMA.

product.name: LIDOMA Showdown
product.description: A Free Fire tournament organized by LIDOMA, featuring 24 teams competing over 8 days for a $2000 prize.

product.name: LIWA Village
product.description: A dedicated gaming village in Abu Dhabi established by LIDOMA in collaboration with LIWA Village and Tencent, featuring various gaming zones and esports events.

product.name: Esports Event Management
product.description: LIDOMA's service of organizing and managing esports events, including planning, marketing, and production across multiple regions.
